regions.title: THE ACTIVATION PLAQUE
regions.text: 269568 on the warehouse wall is the epoch at which Dencun activated on 13 March 2024. It is an epoch number, not a block height or shipment code.
regions.alt: The activation plaque. 269568 on the warehouse wall is the epoch at which Dencun activated on 13 March 2024. It is an epoch number, not a block height or shipment code.

regions.title: THE HOURGLASS TAG
regions.text: 4096 EPOCHS marks the minimum blob-sidecar retention and serving window, about eighteen days. It does not require every copy to disappear when that time is up.
regions.alt: The hourglass tag. 4096 EPOCHS marks the minimum blob-sidecar retention and serving window, about eighteen days. It does not require every copy to disappear when that time is up.

regions.title: THE ARB SUITCASE
regions.text: ARB links the cargo to Arbitrum. The CANCUN sticker names the execution-layer half of Dencun, paired with Deneb on the consensus layer. The label is a naming clue, not a travel destination or upgrade venue.
regions.alt: The arb suitcase. ARB links the cargo to Arbitrum. The CANCUN sticker names the execution-layer half of Dencun, paired with Deneb on the consensus layer. The label is a naming clue, not a travel destination or upgrade venue.

regions.title: THE RETURNING TRAVELLER
regions.text: The 087 pocket badge recalls The Arbitrum Airdrop card. This fictional tortoise now uses wheels to carry the load. The callback connects two illustrations; it does not identify a historical actor or claim faster L1 block production.
